about_the_game:
The village of Hungwood is under attack!  But where are all the heroes?  An evil knight has imprisoned them all, allowing enemies to wreak havoc!

It's up to the merchant/leaf-caster Rodin to form a group of NPCs formidable enough to rescue the heroes and save Hungwood!

But it's not all work and no play!  Many enemies would rather have fun than fight, and taking a more friendly approach can turn enemies to your side without having to kill them!

A Lust To Win RPG With Party Mechanics!

You're not alone in your mission!  Four noble NPCs have stepped up to join your cause, and they're ready to party with some willing enemies too!

Join forces with the dwarven blacksmith and runecaster Dorik, the cuddly orc Murag, the somber Gildrath, and the seductive human/werewolf Cliff!

You'll meet all the main character/love interests in this demo, get to know them, and complete the entire map of Hungwood!  That's the entire level 1 of the game.

An RPG / Visual Novel!

Get a true taste of the full game with two pinup scenes and multiple mini-scenes with the enemies.  You'll also start your romantic journey with the love interests.

Loaded with Features!

  • The Entire Level 1 (of 6) Map to Clear

  • 4 (of 26) Different 'Lustable' Humanoid Enemies With Generous Mini-Scenes!

  • The first (of Six) 'Lustable' Humanoid Miniboss! 

  • The Start of the Romance with Your 4 Party Members!

  • An Inventory System of Upgradable Items and Weapons

  • Multiple Non-Lustable Enemies For XP, Gold, and Loot!

  • A Beginning to the Visual Novel Storyline of Love, Lore, and Discovery

content_descriptors.notes: Contains explicit sexual content between two or more consenting adults.
